architecture.name: Solutions Architect – Associate (SAA-C03)
architecture.qualification: The course follows SAA-C03. AWS's exam guide targets candidates with at least one year of hands-on cloud-solution design experience.

development.name: Developer – Associate
development.qualification: The provider currently lists DVA-C02. AWS opens DVA-C03 registration on October 27, 2026; the final DVA-C02 exam date is November 30, 2026. Check course coverage for your target exam version.

operations.name: CloudOps Engineer – Associate
operations.qualification: The provider lists the current CloudOps Engineer course. AWS describes its exam audience as people with about one year of experience deploying, managing, and operating AWS workloads.

advancedNetworking.name: Advanced Networking – Specialty
advancedNetworking.qualification: The provider course page covers ANS-C01. AWS's final ANS-C01 exam date is December 31, 2026; no new Advanced Networking credentials will be issued after retirement. Check the current AWS exam page before planning a certification attempt.
